findings.title: A fully persisted tool result cannot resume across the post-result checkpoint boundary
findings.requirement: SPEC0224 sections 2, 3.2 and TR06: acknowledged complete results survive recreation and resume without another tool body.
findings.evidence: Own public factory reproduction saved a valid V2 checkpoint with stepNumber=0, pendingStepNumber=1 and a COMPLETE 4096-byte result; the native step ledger already had step 1 SUCCEEDED. Subsequent writes were refused to preserve that boundary, then the factory/runtime was recreated over the same memory store and journal. Resume returned INTERNAL_FAILURE: Step transition SUCCEEDED -> RUNNING is not allowed. One body and one model call total; no replay occurred, but the saved result could not reach the next decision.
findings.mechanism: The missing-result recovery guard only handles SUCCEEDED without an observation. When the full observation exists, pendingDecision is dispatched again and beforeDispatch unconditionally records RUNNING over the already successful native step.
findings.repro: repro.test.ts test 'TR06 resumes a durably saved full result after recreating the public runtime'; run argv in repro-r2.command.json
findings.scope: Deterministic factory/runtime recreation in one process using real in-memory stores and synthetic ports; not an independent PostgreSQL process-restart run. The later public PG addendum fails before this saved-result boundary, so it does not independently corroborate this exact failure.

findings.title: User resume still slices away mandatory tool results at the 50-observation boundary
findings.requirement: SPEC0224 section 3.2 lines 172–181 and TR08: retain every TOOL_RESULT; optional observations may leave whole, tools may not be removed by slice50.
findings.evidence: Own factory reproduction ran 50 rules-only synthetic tools, then paused for ASK_USER with exactly 50 retained TOOL_RESULT observations. Supplying the user answer produced INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and 'Value is not strict JSON'. The durable checkpoint stayed at NEEDS_USER_INPUT with all 50 results; no model/body ran during resume.
findings.mechanism: applyResume appends USER_MESSAGE and applies slice(-MAX_CHECKPOINT_OBSERVATIONS) unconditionally, evicting the first tool result in live state. CAS retention validation then attempts to canonicalize the missing old observation and fails. Durable integrity prevents silent loss, but valid user resumption becomes unusable.
findings.repro: repro.test.ts test 'TR08 user resume preserves all 50 mandatory tool observations'; run argv in repro-r2.command.json
findings.scope: Actual public factory, rules, native dispatch and memory CAS; no service.

findings.title: The JSON depth limit counts the root at zero instead of the approved depth one
findings.requirement: SPEC0224 section 3 table line 82 explicitly counts the root at depth 1, maximum depth 32; TR02 requires rejecting depth 33.
findings.evidence: Own public factory returned COMPLETED for 32 nested arrays around null: the leaf has approved depth 33. The observation was COMPLETE and two model calls occurred, whereas RESULT_COMPLEXITY/UNAVAILABLE and no second model call were required.
findings.mechanism: visit(value, 0) combined with depth > maxDepth accepts one extra level. The shipped unit test explicitly asserts 'root-at-zero' semantics and passes, so the green test encodes a different requirement.
findings.repro: repro.test.ts test 'TR02 root depth 1: rejects a 33-level result before the next model'; run argv in repro-r2.command.json
findings.scope: Public complete-tool-v1 path, not just a serializer mock.

findings.title: Native settlement accepts a receipt belonging to another decision step
findings.requirement: SPEC0224 sections 3.2 and 5.2: idempotent settlement is allowed for the same binding; a receipt from another step conflicts.
findings.evidence: Own direct native-port reproduction reserved and settled a step-1 receipt, confirmed same-port idempotency, then supplied the same settlement to a step-2 CompleteDecisionAdmission over the same run. It returned the step-1 SETTLED receipt instead of STATE_CONFLICT.
findings.mechanism: settleNow checks tenant/execution/request digest, but never record.stepNumber against options.stepNumber before its SETTLED fast return.
findings.repro: repro.test.ts test 'TR05 same-step settlement is idempotent but another step must reject the binding'; run argv in repro-r2.command.json
findings.scope: Direct native admission port with synthetic run and no-op persistence, not the public factory. This repro does not demonstrate double billing or an unauthorized effect; it demonstrates the missing step-binding rejection.
